sanskritDevanagari:
उत्तरो गोपतिर्गोप्ता ज्ञानगम्यः पुरातनः ।
शरीरभूतभृद्भोक्ता कपीन्द्रो भूरिदक्षिणः ॥ ५३॥
transliteration:
uttaro gopatirgoptā jñānagamyaḥ purātanaḥ |
śarīrabhūtabhṛdbhoktā kapīndro bhūridakṣiṇaḥ || 53 ||

names.name: उत्तरः
names.meaning: The superior one; He who transcends all beings by the excellence of His nature, knowledge, and power

names.name: गोपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of the earth and of speech; the protector of all cattle, the Vedas, and the world

names.name: गोप्ता
names.meaning: The protector; He who guards and shelters all beings as a cowherd protects his flock

names.name: ज्ञानगम्यः
names.meaning: He who is attainable through knowledge alone; the supreme reality accessible only through jnana

names.name: पुरातनः
names.meaning: The most ancient one; He who existed before all of creation and is the primordial being

names.name: शरीरभूतभृत्
names.meaning: The sustainer of the elements that constitute the body; He who supports the five great elements forming all physical forms

names.name: भोक्ता
names.meaning: The enjoyer; He who experiences the bliss of His own infinite nature and who is the ultimate experiencer in all beings

names.name: कपीन्द्रः
names.meaning: The Lord of the monkeys; He who as Rama commanded Hanuman and the vanara hosts, or the supreme among sages

names.name: भूरिदक्षिणः
names.meaning: He who gives abundantly; the supremely generous one who bestows lavish rewards upon His devotees

sanskritDevanagari:
सोमपोऽमृतपः सोमः पुरुजित्पुरुसत्तमः ।
विनयो जयः सत्यसन्धो दाशार्हः सात्वताम्पतिः ॥ ५४॥
transliteration:
somapo'mṛtapaḥ somaḥ purujitpurusattamaḥ |
vinayo jayaḥ satyasandho dāśārhaḥ sātvatāmpatiḥ || 54 ||

names.name: सोमपः
names.meaning: He who drinks the Soma; the Lord who receives the soma oblations offered in Vedic sacrifices

names.name: अमृतपः
names.meaning: He who drinks the nectar of immortality; the one who partakes of the bliss of His own eternal nature

names.name: सोमः
names.meaning: He who is the moon; the nourisher of all plants and beings through the cooling nectar of His grace

names.name: पुरुजित्
names.meaning: The conqueror of many; He who has vanquished numerous enemies and demons in His divine incarnations

names.name: पुरुसत्तमः
names.meaning: The best among beings; the most excellent of all purushas, supreme in virtue and greatness

names.name: विनयः
names.meaning: He who embodies humility; the one who disciplines the wicked and guides the righteous with gentle grace

names.name: जयः
names.meaning: He who is victory itself; the one who always triumphs and from whom all conquest originates

names.name: सत्यसन्धः
names.meaning: He whose resolve is always true; the one whose vows and promises are unfailingly fulfilled

names.name: दाशार्हः
names.meaning: He who was born in the Dasharha clan; a descendant of the illustrious Yadu dynasty as Lord Krishna

names.name: सात्वतांपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of the Satvatas; the master and protector of the Yadava devotees who follow the path of devotion

sanskritDevanagari:
जीवो विनयिता साक्षी मुकुन्दोऽमितविक्रमः ।
अम्भोनिधिरनन्तात्मा महोदधिशयोऽन्तकः ॥ ५५॥
transliteration:
jīvo vinayitā sākṣī mukundo'mitavikramaḥ |
ambhonidhiranantātmā mahodadhiśayo'ntakaḥ || 55 ||

names.name: जीवः
names.meaning: The life principle; He who as the inner Self animates all living beings with the breath of life

names.name: विनयिता
names.meaning: The great discipliner; He who humbles the proud and subdues those who stray from the path of dharma

names.name: साक्षी
names.meaning: The eternal witness; He who directly perceives all events in all beings without being affected or altered

names.name: मुकुन्दः
names.meaning: The bestower of liberation; He who grants mukti (freedom from the cycle of birth and death) to His devotees

names.name: अमितविक्रमः
names.meaning: He of immeasurable valor; the one whose prowess and heroic strides are boundless, as shown in the Vamana avatara

names.name: अम्भोनिधिः
names.meaning: The ocean; He who is the vast reservoir of all waters and the abode of infinite depth and mystery

names.name: अनन्तात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is infinite; the one whose nature is without limit in space, time, or attribute

names.name: महोदधिशयः
names.meaning: He who reclines upon the great ocean; the Lord who rests on the cosmic waters as Narayana on Adishesha

names.name: अन्तकः
names.meaning: He who brings about the end; the destroyer who dissolves all beings at the time of cosmic dissolution

sanskritDevanagari:
अजो महार्हः स्वाभाव्यो जितामित्रः प्रमोदनः ।
आनन्दो नन्दनो नन्दः सत्यधर्मा त्रिविक्रमः ॥ ५६॥
transliteration:
ajo mahārhaḥ svābhāvyo jitāmitraḥ pramodanaḥ |
ānando nandano nandaḥ satyadharmā trivikramaḥ || 56 ||

names.name: अजः
names.meaning: The unborn; He who has no origin and is never subject to birth, being the eternal uncaused cause

names.name: महार्हः
names.meaning: He who is worthy of the highest worship; the most deserving recipient of all devotional offerings

names.name: स्वाभाव्यः
names.meaning: He who is eternally established in His own nature; the one whose greatness is inherent and self-existing

names.name: जितामित्रः
names.meaning: He who has conquered all enemies; the invincible Lord who subdues both internal and external foes

names.name: प्रमोदनः
names.meaning: He who is always full of delight; the one who fills His devotees with supreme joy and celebration

names.name: आनन्दः
names.meaning: He who is bliss itself; the supreme reality whose essential nature is pure, unconditioned happiness

names.name: नन्दनः
names.meaning: He who brings joy to others; the one who delights all beings and fills them with happiness

names.name: नन्दः
names.meaning: He who is endowed with all joyful perfections; the one who is free from all worldly desires and full of bliss

names.name: सत्यधर्मा
names.meaning: He whose dharma is truth; the one who embodies and upholds truth as the highest righteous principle

names.name: त्रिविक्रमः
names.meaning: He who covered the three worlds in three strides; the Vamana incarnation who measured earth, sky, and heaven

sanskritDevanagari:
महर्षिः कपिलाचार्यः कृतज्ञो मेदिनीपतिः ।
त्रिपदस्त्रिदशाध्यक्षो महाशृङ्गः कृतान्तकृत् ॥ ५७॥
transliteration:
maharṣiḥ kapilācāryaḥ kṛtajño medinīpatiḥ |
tripadastridaśādhyakṣo mahāśṛṅgaḥ kṛtāntakṛt || 57 ||

names.name: महर्षिः
names.meaning: The great sage; He who is the supreme rishi and the source of all sacred knowledge and revelation

names.name: कपिलाचार्यः
names.meaning: The teacher Kapila; He who incarnated as the sage Kapila, the founder of the Sankhya philosophy

names.name: कृतज्ञः
names.meaning: He who knows all that has been done; the grateful Lord who remembers even the smallest offering of His devotees

names.name: मेदिनीपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of the earth; the sovereign protector and ruler of the entire terrestrial world

names.name: त्रिपदः
names.meaning: He who has three strides; the Vamana who encompassed the three realms, or He who is reached by three steps of knowledge

names.name: त्रिदशाध्यक्षः
names.meaning: The overlord of the thirty-three devas; the supreme presiding deity of all celestial beings

names.name: महाशृङ्गः
names.meaning: He with the great horn; the Matsya avatara who bore a magnificent horn, or the supreme cosmic peak

names.name: कृतान्तकृत्
names.meaning: He who destroys even death; the Lord who puts an end to Yama's power and overcomes the finality of death itself

sanskritDevanagari:
महावराहो गोविन्दः सुषेणः कनकाङ्गदी ।
गुह्यो गभीरो गहनो गुप्तश्चक्रगदाधरः ॥ ५८॥
transliteration:
mahāvarāho govindaḥ suṣeṇaḥ kanakāṅgadī |
guhyo gabhīro gahano guptaścakragadādharaḥ || 58 ||

names.name: महावराहः
names.meaning: The great boar; He who assumed the colossal Varaha form to rescue the earth from the cosmic ocean

names.name: गोविन्दः
names.meaning: The finder of the cows and the Vedas; He who recovered the earth and is known through Vedic speech

names.name: सुषेणः
names.meaning: He who has a splendid army; the Lord whose divine hosts and celestial forces are glorious and invincible

names.name: कनकाङ्गदी
names.meaning: He who wears golden armlets; the resplendent Lord adorned with brilliant gold ornaments on His arms

names.name: गुह्यः
names.meaning: The mysterious one; He who is hidden in the cave of the heart and is the most secret of all truths

names.name: गभीरः
names.meaning: The unfathomable; He whose nature, power, and wisdom are of immeasurable depth

names.name: गहनः
names.meaning: The impenetrable; He who is difficult to comprehend, like a dense and trackless forest of mystery

names.name: गुप्तः
names.meaning: The hidden one; He who is concealed by His own maya and is not perceivable by ordinary senses

names.name: चक्रगदाधरः
names.meaning: He who bears the discus and the mace; the Lord who wields the Sudarshana Chakra and the Kaumodaki Gada

sanskritDevanagari:
वेधाः स्वाङ्गोऽजितः कृष्णो दृढः सङ्कर्षणोऽच्युतः ।
वरुणो वारुणो वृक्षः पुष्कराक्षो महामनाः ॥ ५९॥
transliteration:
vedhāḥ svāṅgo'jitaḥ kṛṣṇo dṛḍhaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo'cyutaḥ |
varuṇo vāruṇo vṛkṣaḥ puṣkarākṣo mahāmanāḥ || 59 ||

names.name: वेधाः
names.meaning: The creator; He who brings forth the universe and ordains the destinies of all beings through His cosmic will

names.name: स्वाङ्गः
names.meaning: He whose limbs are beautiful by their own nature; the self-sufficient Lord who needs no external adornment

names.name: अजितः
names.meaning: The unconquered; He who has never been defeated by anyone and remains eternally invincible

names.name: कृष्णः
names.meaning: The dark-complexioned one; He who is the all-attractive supreme being, drawing all souls to Himself

names.name: दृढः
names.meaning: The firm and steadfast; He whose nature, resolve, and existence are absolutely unshakeable

names.name: सङ्कर्षणः
names.meaning: He who draws all beings together at the time of dissolution; the Balarama form who attracts all souls

names.name: अच्युतः
names.meaning: He who never falls from His glory; the infallible one who never declines from His supreme state

names.name: वरुणः
names.meaning: He who envelops and covers; the deity of the cosmic waters who conceals all within Himself

names.name: वारुणः
names.meaning: The son of Varuna; He who is associated with the lord of the waters, or the sage Vasishtha born of Varuna

names.name: वृक्षः
names.meaning: The tree of the world; He who is the eternal Ashvattha tree of samsara rooted in Brahman

names.name: पुष्कराक्षः
names.meaning: The lotus-eyed one; He whose beautiful eyes resemble lotus petals radiating compassion and grace

names.name: महामनाः
names.meaning: The great-minded one; He whose mind encompasses all of creation with infinite knowledge and compassion

sanskritDevanagari:
भगवान् भगहाऽऽनन्दी वनमाली हलायुधः ।
आदित्यो ज्योतिरादित्यः सहिष्णुर्गतिसत्तमः ॥ ६०॥
transliteration:
bhagavān bhagahā''nandī vanamālī halāyudhaḥ |
ādityo jyotirādityaḥ sahiṣṇurgatisattamaḥ || 60 ||

names.name: भगवान्
names.meaning: The possessor of all six divine attributes: lordship, righteousness, glory, wealth, knowledge, and detachment

names.name: भगहा
names.meaning: The destroyer of fortune of the unrighteous; He who removes the worldly attachments of those He liberates

names.name: आनन्दी
names.meaning: He who is full of bliss; the Lord who eternally revels in the joy of His own supreme nature

names.name: वनमाली
names.meaning: He who wears the Vaijayanti garland of forest flowers; the Lord adorned with the fragrant wildflower wreath

names.name: हलायुधः
names.meaning: He who wields the plough as His weapon; Balarama who bears the divine plough Hala in His hand

names.name: आदित्यः
names.meaning: The son of Aditi; He who manifests as the supreme solar deity, the golden brilliance within the sun

names.name: ज्योतिरादित्यः
names.meaning: The radiance within the sun; He who is the luminous splendor that illumines the sun itself

names.name: सहिष्णुः
names.meaning: The supremely patient one; He who endures all opposites with infinite forbearance and equanimity

names.name: गतिसत्तमः
names.meaning: The greatest refuge; He who is the supreme destination and the most excellent goal of all beings

sanskritDevanagari:
सुधन्वा खण्डपरशुर्दारुणो द्रविणप्रदः ।
दिवस्पृक् सर्वदृग्व्यासो वाचस्पतिरयोनिजः ॥ ६१॥
transliteration:
sudhanvā khaṇḍaparaśurdāruṇo draviṇapradaḥ |
divaspṛk sarvadṛgvyāso vācaspatirayonijaḥ || 61 ||

names.name: सुधन्वा
names.meaning: He who possesses a magnificent bow; the Lord whose divine bow Sharnga is supremely beautiful and powerful

names.name: खण्डपरशुः
names.meaning: He who wields the broken axe; or He who shatters with His axe, as Parashurama who destroyed the kshatriyas

names.name: दारुणः
names.meaning: The terrifying one; He who is merciless toward the wicked and strikes fear into the hearts of the unrighteous

names.name: द्रविणप्रदः
names.meaning: The bestower of wealth; He who generously grants material prosperity and spiritual riches to His devotees

names.name: दिवस्पृक्
names.meaning: He who touches the sky; the Lord whose glory reaches the highest heavens and pervades the celestial realms

names.name: सर्वदृग्व्यासः
names.meaning: The all-seeing Vyasa; He who, as sage Vyasa, perceived all truths and classified the Vedas for humanity

names.name: वाचस्पतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of speech; He who is the master of all eloquence and the presiding deity of sacred utterance

names.name: अयोनिजः
names.meaning: He who is not born from a womb; the Lord who manifests without any material origin or physical birth

sanskritDevanagari:
त्रिसामा सामगः साम निर्वाणं भेषजं भिषक् ।
संन्यासकृच्छमः शान्तो निष्ठा शान्तिः परायणम् ॥ ६२॥
transliteration:
trisāmā sāmagaḥ sāma nirvāṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhiṣak |
saṃnyāsakṛcchamaḥ śānto niṣṭhā śāntiḥ parāyaṇam || 62 ||

names.name: त्रिसामा
names.meaning: He who is praised by the three Sama hymns — Devavrata, Rathantara, and Brihat — the essence of Sama Veda

names.name: सामगः
names.meaning: The singer of the Sama Veda; He who is the melodious chant of the sacred hymns and their ultimate meaning

names.name: साम
names.meaning: He who is the Sama Veda itself; the Lord who is the essence of divine music and Vedic harmony

names.name: निर्वाणम्
names.meaning: He who is supreme bliss and liberation; the ultimate state of extinction of all suffering and ignorance

names.name: भेषजम्
names.meaning: The divine medicine; He who is the supreme remedy that cures the disease of worldly existence (samsara)

names.name: भिषक्
names.meaning: The divine physician; He who heals the afflictions of birth and death and treats the ailment of ignorance

names.name: संन्यासकृत्
names.meaning: The establisher of renunciation; He who instituted the sacred order of sannyasa for the liberation of souls

names.name: शमः
names.meaning: He who is tranquility itself; the supreme peace and inner calm that transcends all mental agitation

names.name: शान्तः
names.meaning: The peaceful one; He who is completely serene, having subdued all passions and disturbances

names.name: निष्ठा
names.meaning: The ultimate abode; He in whom all beings finally rest and find their supreme fulfillment

names.name: शान्तिः
names.meaning: He who is peace itself; the supreme tranquility that is the final goal of all spiritual seeking

names.name: परायणम्
names.meaning: The supreme goal; the highest refuge and ultimate destination to which all spiritual paths lead

sanskritDevanagari:
शुभाङ्गः शान्तिदः स्रष्टा कुमुदः कुवलेशयः ।
गोहितो गोपतिर्गोप्ता वृषभाक्षो वृषप्रियः ॥ ६३॥
transliteration:
śubhāṅgaḥ śāntidaḥ sraṣṭā kumudaḥ kuvalēśayaḥ |
gohito gopatirgoptā vṛṣabhākṣo vṛṣapriyaḥ || 63 ||

names.name: शुभाङ्गः
names.meaning: He of auspicious limbs; the Lord whose every part is divinely beautiful and radiates sacred grace

names.name: शान्तिदः
names.meaning: The bestower of peace; He who grants supreme tranquility and inner stillness to His devotees

names.name: स्रष्टा
names.meaning: The creator; He who projects the entire universe from Himself at the beginning of each cosmic cycle

names.name: कुमुदः
names.meaning: He who delights the earth; the Lord who brings joy to the world, like the kumuda (white water lily) that blossoms in moonlight

names.name: कुवलेशयः
names.meaning: He who reclines on the waters; the Lord who rests upon the cosmic ocean, or He who dwells in the lotus of the heart

names.name: गोहितः
names.meaning: He who acts for the welfare of the earth and cows; the benefactor of speech, knowledge, and all living beings

names.name: गोपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of the earth; the master and protector of all cattle, speech, and living creatures

names.name: गोप्ता
names.meaning: The protector; He who shields and safeguards the entire creation from harm and destruction

names.name: वृषभाक्षः
names.meaning: He whose eyes shower blessings of dharma; the Lord whose gracious glance bestows righteousness upon all

names.name: वृषप्रियः
names.meaning: He who delights in dharma; the Lord who loves righteousness and is pleased by virtuous conduct

sanskritDevanagari:
अनिवर्ती निवृत्तात्मा सङ्क्षेप्ता क्षेमकृच्छिवः ।
श्रीवत्सवक्षाः श्रीवासः श्रीपतिः श्रीमतांवरः ॥ ६४॥
transliteration:
anivartī nivṛttātmā saṅkṣeptā kṣemakṛcchivaḥ |
śrīvatsavakṣāḥ śrīvāsaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmatāṃvaraḥ || 64 ||

names.name: अनिवर्ती
names.meaning: He who never retreats; the Lord who never turns back from battle, truth, or the protection of His devotees

names.name: निवृत्तात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is turned away from worldly existence; the Lord who is completely free from material attachments

names.name: सङ्क्षेप्ता
names.meaning: He who contracts and withdraws; the Lord who draws the entire creation back into Himself at dissolution

names.name: क्षेमकृत्
names.meaning: He who creates well-being; the Lord who ensures the safety, security, and welfare of all beings

names.name: शिवः
names.meaning: The auspicious and pure one; He who bestows supreme blessedness and is intrinsically good and holy

names.name: श्रीवत्सवक्षाः
names.meaning: He who bears the Srivatsa mark on His chest; the Lord on whose breast resides the sacred curl symbolizing Lakshmi

names.name: श्रीवासः
names.meaning: He in whom Shri (Lakshmi) eternally dwells; the permanent abode of all divine prosperity and grace

names.name: श्रीपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of Shri (Lakshmi); the divine consort and master of the goddess of fortune and auspiciousness

names.name: श्रीमतांवरः
names.meaning: The best among the glorious; the most excellent of all who possess divine splendor and prosperity

sanskritDevanagari:
श्रीदः श्रीशः श्रीनिवासः श्रीनिधिः श्रीविभावनः ।
श्रीधरः श्रीकरः श्रेयः श्रीमाँल्लोकत्रयाश्रयः ॥ ६५॥
transliteration:
śrīdaḥ śrīśaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ śrīnidhiḥ śrīvibhāvanaḥ |
śrīdharaḥ śrīkaraḥ śreyaḥ śrīmāṃllōkatrayāśrayaḥ || 65 ||

names.name: श्रीदः
names.meaning: The giver of Shri; He who bestows wealth, beauty, and auspiciousness upon His devotees

names.name: श्रीशः
names.meaning: The Lord of Shri; He who is the supreme master and controller of all divine prosperity

names.name: श्रीनिवासः
names.meaning: He in whom Shri resides; the eternal dwelling place of Lakshmi and all auspiciousness

names.name: श्रीनिधिः
names.meaning: The treasure of Shri; He who is the inexhaustible storehouse of all divine wealth and glory

names.name: श्रीविभावनः
names.meaning: He who manifests Shri everywhere; the Lord who creates and distributes divine prosperity throughout creation

names.name: श्रीधरः
names.meaning: The bearer of Shri; He who carries Lakshmi upon His chest and upholds all that is sacred and beautiful

names.name: श्रीकरः
names.meaning: He who makes everything auspicious; the Lord whose very touch or glance confers divine grace and prosperity

names.name: श्रेयः
names.meaning: The supreme good; He who is the highest spiritual welfare and the ultimate benefit for all beings

names.name: श्रीमान्
names.meaning: He who is ever endowed with Shri; the Lord who eternally possesses all divine splendor, beauty, and majesty

names.name: लोकत्रयाश्रयः
names.meaning: The refuge of the three worlds; He who is the support and shelter of the celestial, terrestrial, and nether realms

sanskritDevanagari:
स्वक्षः स्वङ्गः शतानन्दो नन्दिर्ज्योतिर्गणेश्वरः ।
विजितात्माऽविधेयात्मा सत्कीर्तिश्छिन्नसंशयः ॥ ६६॥
transliteration:
svakṣaḥ svaṅgaḥ śatānando nandirjyotirgaṇeśvaraḥ |
vijitātmā'vidheyātmā satkīrtiśchinnasaṃśayaḥ || 66 ||

names.name: स्वक्षः
names.meaning: He who has beautiful eyes; the Lord whose divine eyes see everything with perfect clarity and grace

names.name: स्वङ्गः
names.meaning: He who has beautiful limbs; the Lord whose divine form is supremely graceful and perfectly proportioned

names.name: शतानन्दः
names.meaning: He of hundredfold bliss; the Lord who possesses infinite varieties and degrees of supreme joy

names.name: नन्दिः
names.meaning: He who is blissful; the Lord who is the embodiment of divine happiness and causes joy in others

names.name: ज्योतिर्गणेश्वरः
names.meaning: The lord of the hosts of luminaries; He who commands the sun, moon, stars, and all celestial lights

names.name: विजितात्मा
names.meaning: He who has completely conquered the Self; the Lord who has perfect mastery over His own divine nature

names.name: अविधेयात्मा
names.meaning: He who cannot be controlled by anyone; the Lord whose Self is independent and subject to no external authority

names.name: सत्कीर्तिः
names.meaning: He of true fame; the Lord whose glory is real, imperishable, and celebrated throughout all worlds

names.name: छिन्नसंशयः
names.meaning: He who has destroyed all doubts; the Lord in whom no uncertainty exists and who dispels the doubts of devotees

sanskritDevanagari:
उदीर्णः सर्वतश्चक्षुरनीशः शाश्वतस्थिरः ।
भूशयो भूषणो भूतिर्विशोकः शोकनाशनः ॥ ६७॥
transliteration:
udīrṇaḥ sarvataścakṣuranīśaḥ śāśvatasthiraḥ |
bhūśayo bhūṣaṇo bhūtirviśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ || 67 ||

names.name: उदीर्णः
names.meaning: The exalted one; He who transcends all beings and is supremely elevated above the entire creation

names.name: सर्वतश्चक्षुः
names.meaning: He whose eyes are everywhere; the omniscient Lord who sees all things in all directions simultaneously

names.name: अनीशः
names.meaning: He who has no master above Him; the absolutely sovereign Lord who is ruled by no one

names.name: शाश्वतस्थिरः
names.meaning: He who is eternally stable; the Lord who is both everlasting and immovably fixed in His supreme nature

names.name: भूशयः
names.meaning: He who rests upon the earth; the Lord who reclines on the ground in His simplicity, as Rama in the forest

names.name: भूषणः
names.meaning: The adorner; He who embellishes the entire universe with beauty or who is Himself the ornament of all worlds

names.name: भूतिः
names.meaning: He who is pure existence and glory; the Lord who is the source of all prosperity and magnificence

names.name: विशोकः
names.meaning: He who is free from all sorrow; the Lord who is untouched by grief, lamentation, or any form of suffering

names.name: शोकनाशनः
names.meaning: The destroyer of sorrow; He who annihilates the grief and suffering of those who take refuge in Him

sanskritDevanagari:
अर्चिष्मानर्चितः कुम्भो विशुद्धात्मा विशोधनः ।
अनिरुद्धोऽप्रतिरथः प्रद्युम्नोऽमितविक्रमः ॥ ६८॥
transliteration:
arciṣmānarcitaḥ kumbho viśuddhātmā viśodhanaḥ |
aniruddho'pratirathaḥ pradyumno'mitavikramaḥ || 68 ||

names.name: अर्चिष्मान्
names.meaning: He who is radiant with light; the Lord who shines with brilliant effulgence like innumerable rays of splendor

names.name: अर्चितः
names.meaning: He who is worshipped; the Lord who is adored by all beings including Brahma, Shiva, and the devas

names.name: कुम्भः
names.meaning: He who contains everything within Himself; the cosmic vessel that holds the entire universe like a pot

names.name: विशुद्धात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is supremely pure; the Lord whose nature is absolutely untainted by any trace of impurity

names.name: विशोधनः
names.meaning: The supreme purifier; He who cleanses His devotees of all sins and impurities through His divine grace

names.name: अनिरुद्धः
names.meaning: He who cannot be obstructed; the irresistible Lord whom no force can restrain, also the grandson of Krishna

names.name: अप्रतिरथः
names.meaning: He who has no equal adversary; the matchless warrior whom no chariot-fighter can ever oppose or defeat

names.name: प्रद्युम्नः
names.meaning: He of supreme splendor; the Lord of great brilliance, also the divine son of Krishna and Rukmini

names.name: अमितविक्रमः
names.meaning: He of boundless prowess; the Lord whose valor and heroic stride are immeasurable, as in the Vamana avatara

sanskritDevanagari:
कालनेमिनिहा वीरः शौरिः शूरजनेश्वरः ।
त्रिलोकात्मा त्रिलोकेशः केशवः केशिहा हरिः ॥ ६९॥
transliteration:
kālaneminihā vīraḥ śauriḥ śūrajaneśvaraḥ |
trilokātmā trilokeśaḥ keśavaḥ keśihā hariḥ || 69 ||

names.name: कालनेमिनिहा
names.meaning: The slayer of Kalanemi; He who destroyed the demon Kalanemi, who was an adversary of the gods

names.name: वीरः
names.meaning: The heroic one; He who is supremely valiant and displays unmatched courage in the protection of dharma

names.name: शौरिः
names.meaning: The descendant of Shura; He who was born in the lineage of the heroic Shura, the grandfather of Krishna

names.name: शूरजनेश्वरः
names.meaning: The Lord of the valiant; He who is the master and commander of all heroic and brave beings

names.name: त्रिलोकात्मा
names.meaning: The Self of the three worlds; He who is the indwelling spirit and essence of the celestial, terrestrial, and subterranean realms

names.name: त्रिलोकेशः
names.meaning: The Lord of the three worlds; the supreme sovereign who rules over heaven, earth, and the netherworld

names.name: केशवः
names.meaning: He who has beautiful hair; or He who is the combined form of Brahma (Ka), Shiva (Isha), and Vishnu — the supreme trinity

names.name: केशिहा
names.meaning: The slayer of the demon Keshi; He who as Krishna destroyed the horse-demon Keshi sent by Kamsa

names.name: हरिः
names.meaning: He who removes ignorance and sin; the one who takes away all suffering and who is of captivating green-golden hue

sanskritDevanagari:
कामदेवः कामपालः कामी कान्तः कृतागमः ।
अनिर्देश्यवपुर्विष्णुर्वीरोऽनन्तो धनञ्जयः ॥ ७०॥
transliteration:
kāmadevaḥ kāmapālaḥ kāmī kāntaḥ kṛtāgamaḥ |
anirdeśyavapurviṣṇurvīro'nanto dhanañjayaḥ || 70 ||

names.name: कामदेवः
names.meaning: The God of love and desire; He who is sought after by all beings desiring the four goals of life (dharma, artha, kama, moksha)

names.name: कामपालः
names.meaning: The fulfiller of desires; He who protects and fulfills the legitimate wishes of His devoted seekers

names.name: कामी
names.meaning: He who has fulfilled all desires; the Lord who possesses all that is desirable and whose every wish is already accomplished

names.name: कान्तः
names.meaning: The supremely beautiful one; He who is infinitely attractive and enchanting to all beings

names.name: कृतागमः
names.meaning: The author of the scriptures; He who revealed the Vedas, Agamas, and all sacred texts for the guidance of humanity

names.name: अनिर्देश्यवपुः
names.meaning: He whose form is indescribable; the Lord whose divine body transcends all words, thought, and characterization

names.name: विष्णुः
names.meaning: The all-pervading one; He who permeates every atom of the universe and transcends all spatial limitation

names.name: वीरः
names.meaning: The valiant one; He who displays supreme heroism and moves dynamically through all creation

names.name: अनन्तः
names.meaning: The infinite one; He who is limitless in time, space, and attributes, without beginning or end

names.name: धनञ्जयः
names.meaning: The conqueror of wealth; He who wins over all riches, or the vital air that sustains the body after death

sanskritDevanagari:
ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मकृद् ब्रह्मा ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविवर्धनः ।
ब्रह्मविद् ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मी ब्रह्मज्ञो ब्राह्मणप्रियः ॥ ७१॥
transliteration:
brahmaṇyo brahmakṛd brahmā brahma brahmavivardhanaḥ |
brahmavid brāhmaṇo brahmī brahmajño brāhmaṇapriyaḥ || 71 ||

names.name: ब्रह्मण्यः
names.meaning: He who is devoted to Brahman; the Lord who supports the Vedas, brahmanas, and all that is sacred and holy

names.name: ब्रह्मकृत्
names.meaning: The creator of Brahma and the Vedas; He who brings into being the creator-god and all sacred knowledge

names.name: ब्रह्मा
names.meaning: He who is Brahma the creator; the Lord who assumes the form of the cosmic creator to fashion the universe

names.name: ब्रह्म
names.meaning: The supreme Brahman; the infinite, absolute reality that is the ground of all existence and consciousness

names.name: ब्रह्मविवर्धनः
names.meaning: He who expands Brahman; the Lord who causes the Vedas and spiritual knowledge to grow and flourish

names.name: ब्रह्मविद्
names.meaning: The knower of Brahman; He who perfectly comprehends the supreme reality in its totality

names.name: ब्राह्मणः
names.meaning: He who is the true brahmana; the Lord who embodies the highest qualities of wisdom, purity, and spiritual knowledge

names.name: ब्रह्मी
names.meaning: He who is endowed with Brahman; the Lord who possesses the supreme reality as His very essence

names.name: ब्रह्मज्ञः
names.meaning: He who knows the Vedas completely; the omniscient Lord who is the ultimate authority on all sacred knowledge

names.name: ब्राह्मणप्रियः
names.meaning: He who is dear to the brahmanas; the Lord who loves those devoted to spiritual knowledge and Vedic learning

sanskritDevanagari:
महाक्रमो महाकर्मा महातेजा महोरगः ।
महाक्रतुर्महायज्वा महायज्ञो महाहविः ॥ ७२॥
transliteration:
mahākramo mahākarmā mahātejā mahoragaḥ |
mahākraturmahāyajvā mahāyajño mahāhaviḥ || 72 ||

names.name: महाक्रमः
names.meaning: He of the great stride; the Lord whose steps span the entire cosmos, as demonstrated in the Vamana avatara

names.name: महाकर्मा
names.meaning: He of great deeds; the Lord whose actions of creation, preservation, and dissolution are supremely magnificent

names.name: महातेजाः
names.meaning: He of great splendor; the Lord whose radiant energy illumines all worlds and surpasses every other brilliance

names.name: महोरगः
names.meaning: The great serpent; He who manifests as Adishesha, the infinite cosmic serpent upon whom He reclines

names.name: महाक्रतुः
names.meaning: The great sacrifice; He who is the supreme yajna and the ultimate purpose of all Vedic sacrificial rites

names.name: महायज्वा
names.meaning: The great performer of sacrifice; He who is the foremost among all those who conduct sacred rituals and offerings
